title: The Basic Library
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of the Basic Library and the key behavior described in this lesson.
Apply the Basic Library in a small Lua example and predict its result.
Identify a relevant edge case, version constraint, or host-runtime limitation for the Basic Library.

content.intro: The standard libraries cover basic functions, math, strings, tables, coroutines, UTF-8, I/O, OS services and debugging. Embedding hosts can omit or restrict libraries, so treat availability as a runtime assumption.

content_blocks.text: Read the small example, predict every output line, then run it locally with a compatible runtime. Run with the Lua 5.5 interpreter unless the example explicitly names a host API or another runtime. Keep the smallest reproducible case if the observed behavior differs.

items.title: Mistake 1
items.text: Confusing The Basic Library with a similarly named feature in another language or runtime. Fix: follow the version-matched reference and test the smallest example.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.text: Relying on an output order or environment capability that the language/host does not guarantee. Fix: document assumptions and make order/capabilities explicit.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.text: Skipping a boundary test or failing to check error-return values. Fix: test invalid and boundary inputs and inspect failure values.
